lines.t:
A state in which <c:ffff00>defending<c> is not possible.

If an <c:ffff00>action<c>, <c:ffff00>{{negative_status}}<c> or other {{effect}} makes
defense impossible, even a <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> capable of
defending can't give the defend <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c>; having
all such {{part|pl}} destroyed amounts to the same thing.

If an attack is <c:ffff00>taken<c> while unable to defend and
<c:ffff00>unable to evade<c>, it is always <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>.
